data: Original disclosed V5 public development only, 144 unique templates, no new held read
fixed_candidates: one Cell owns seven label heads
two Cells partition identical seven heads
seven Cells each own one head
resource_control: Same frozen encoder, identical trained parameter object, one encoding and exactly seven sparse dot products per request. Only group manifests and dispatch count differ.
adoption: Accept a split only if correct accepted count strictly increases with no increase in wrong known/OOD acceptance, identical weights and primitive arithmetic count, and median dispatch time <=1.10 baseline. Otherwise retain baseline and report no structural gain.
timing: 15 interleaved repetitions over identical preencoded public requests; report dispatch time separately from feature encoding, in one Python process on CPU; not a distributed-runtime benchmark.
numeric_composition: Same router applied to frozen V5 co2 parameter memory/learned typed graph vs strong exact codec/planner, real removed/permuted edge controls and oracle routing; fixed date2020-07; no new numeric or topology training
limits: Partitioning label heads does not invent new capabilities or train new structure
No kernel/agentd live Cell mutation or production adoption
One numerical task repeated over language templates is not independent numerical-domain evidence
No claim of spontaneous general intelligence
